brief: A seven-cell honeycomb work surface, covered on top, with every open outside edge finished with caps.

requirements.evidence: Seven Hex base · Full pieces form a flower: centre (0,0) plus the six ring cells (-1,0),(-1,1),(0,-1),(0,1),(1,-1),(1,0), all at level 0 (piece refs in get_build).
Seven full top covers, one on each base cell (cover:*;full;top), check_build reports no issues and meshClash clear.

requirements.requirement: Every open outside edge finished with caps
requirements.evidence: capOpenFaces added 18 solid end caps on the outer faces of the ring; joints locked with 12 joint bolts via lockJoints. No open-face warnings remain in check_build.

finish.summary: Built a seven-cell hex work surface: seven full bases in a flower layout, each with a top cover, the 18 exposed outside faces capped, and joints locked. check_build is clean with meshClash clear. I did not add props, since the brief concerns structure only. The look tool reported no visible props, so I did not confirm the view visually.

lines.label: M6 x 25 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
